name: QMugs: Quantum Mechanical Properties of Drug-like Molecules
description: QMugs is a quantum mechanical dataset of 665,000 drug-like molecules extracted from the ChEMBL database, containing over 2 million energetically favorable 3D conformers. Computed using density functional theory (DFT wB97X-D/def2-SVP) and semi-empirical methods (GFN2-xTB), QMugs provides high-accuracy single-point energies, atomic charges, orbital energies (HOMO/LUMO), dipole moments, and vibrational frequencies for machine learning drug discovery.
